title.label: Just getting started, but love it!

content.label: Way better than all my voice-to-text options! The ChatGPT one is pretty good, and I was thinking, "Gosh, I wish I had this for email and texting and chatting." It's just nice to have it all in one place, and I can easily take notes when I want it. Seamlessly works between my phone and my laptop. Also, I just wrote this with Wispr 😊
